messages:
incbot: :rotating_light: Pager: high tail latency + 500s for responses from tenant=maplehealth (VPC, dedicated pool). Alert: 95th latency spike > 2.5s and request errors rising. Paging oncall(sylvie)

sylvie: on it. seeing spikes starting ~2418765400. thanks incbot. assigning triage.

kai: I can pull metrics and recent kernel logs. suspicion: KV cache churn after recent quantization profile rolled out to pool. will confirm.

sylvie: good hypothesis. maplehealth reported degraded chat UX. customer impact: interactive features timing out ~15-25% of requests during spikes. notified account team.

nora: @maple-support i posted to the MapleHealth Slack bridge and asked for any recent config changes on their side (network ACLs etc). they said no changes.

dana: quick checklist: 1) isolate traffic by model variant 2) pin safe variant 3) route Maple traffic to fallback pool 4) increase kv_cache size on nodes 5) collect heap/eviction logs.

oliver: putting an emergency route in to avoid hitting the freshly-quantized instances. command: ```
# route MapleHealth to dedicated-fallback-pool
redwoodctl routing update --tenant maplehealth --route default --pool dedicated-fallback-pool --priority 10
```

kai: grabbing live logs. snippet from node-12 KV eviction log: ```
[2418765421] kvcache: evict key=prefix_0 size=48MB total=920MB(limit=1GB) rate=430/s
[2418765423] model_runner: allocate failed quant_buffer mismatch q8->q4
```

sylvie: that quant_buffer mismatch looks like a runtime fallback that causes reinitialization, hence tail latency. plan: pin Maple to v2026-06-safequant (non-evicting profile) and route while we remediate. dana, can you do the pin?

dana: doing it now: ```
redwoodctl models pin --tenant maplehealth --model-id maple-chat-v12 --version v2026-06-safequant
```

incbot: Action logged: model pin requested by dana for tenant maplehealth.

dana: pinned. confirm status: pinned-> v2026-06-safequant (ack).

oliver: route change applied. verifying traffic: tail latency dropping on dedicated-fallback-pool. initial 95p from 2.7s -> 0.9s within 35s. :thumbsup:

kai: continuing to stream logs; eviction rate down after pin, memory stable. still watching for any residual errors.

nora: customer notified: "we've temporarily pinned your model to a stable variant and routed traffic to a contained pool. engineers are investigating root cause and will update within 30 mins."

maple-support: Customer response: they see improvement on their end (UX). They asked whether this will affect throughput or cost. I told them it's temporary and will follow up with SRE/AE.

sylvie: next steps: - run controlled recreation in staging to reproduce quant mismatch - revert quantization profile rollout to pool - increase kv_cache default for pool nodes to 1.5GB - schedule follow-up with Maple PM - prepare status update for status.redwood.ai

dana: creating follow-up ticket: INC-241876 (triage->action). linking logs and commands.

oliver: will keep the emergency route for 2 hours and then evaluate. if stable, we'll plan a coordinated rollout with a canary that avoids q4 paths.

kai: leaving monitoring on. will alert if 95p > 1.5s again.

sylvie: handoff to oncall-sre (dana) for 30m watch. I'm off to coordinate with product for rollback timing. thanks all. :heart:
